name: Hime Hitoyo
source:
The castle is under attacked, and the princess becomes bandits' victim. She will never be the same after this night. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
城堡遭到袭击，公主成为强盗的受害者。经过这一夜，她将永远不再是原来的自己。
